CNN Reader.title: CNN Reader
CNN Reader.subtitle: Digital (web + app)
CNN Reader.description: Unlimited access to CNN's world-class articles and short-form videos on CNN.com and mobile apps. Enjoy CNN's breaking news coverage, real-time analysis and updates, and exclusive subscriber-only content to keep you informed and in the know.

features.name: Unlimited Articles
features.description: Unlimited access to every article on CNN.com and the CNN mobile app.

features.name: Short-Form Video
features.description: Unlimited access to short news video clips from CNN journalists on CNN.com and the CNN mobile app.

features.name: Subscriber-Only Content
features.description: Exclusive reporting, analysis, newsletters and other original subscriber-only journalism focusing on the day's most interesting stories and in-depth investigations from around the globe.

features.name: CNN Reality Check
features.description: One-click fact-checking of news and information across the web, powered by CNN's trusted reporting and enabled by AI.

features.name: Podcast Club
features.description: CNN's Podcast Club, featuring long-form conversations spanning culture, politics, comedy and news, hosted by your favorite independent comedians, journalists and personalities.

features.name: News from Local Providers
features.description: Access curated articles and video clips from your preferred state, city or local news provider – up to 100 pieces of content monthly.

features.name: CNN You
features.description: Personalized experience using AI, adapting your feed to your individual topic interests, consumption preferences and reading behavior.

features.name: CNN Technology Insider
features.description: Premium subscriber-only coverage of the people, trends and stories driving rapidly evolving sectors in technology from leading minds in AI, crypto, mobility, energy, and more.

CNN Reader.note: Access to live TV requires a separate cable/streaming subscription.

CNN Streaming.title: CNN Streaming
CNN Streaming.subtitle: Live & On-Demand Video
CNN Streaming.description: Stay ahead of every story with CNN Streaming, your pass to 24/7 news coverage available anywhere you are. Enjoy the daytime and primetime CNN shows you know and love from cable TV, plus live breaking news coverage, video on-demand, headlines of the day and more from CNN's trusted reporters, anchors and correspondents.

features.name: 24/7 Live News Channel
features.description: Continuous coverage of the day's most important stories, featuring CNN anchors like Anderson Cooper alongside international coverage and original programming.

features.name: Catch Up Channel
features.description: Never miss a headline. This dedicated channel quickly brings you up to speed with a short summary of the day's most important stories.

features.name: CNN Library On-Demand
features.description: Dive into CNN's original series and films, historical coverage, interviews, and award-winning docuseries like Parts Unknown with Anthony Bourdain.

features.name: Curated Video Playlist Channels
features.description: Personalized playlists help keep you up to date on your favorite topics and shows with clips ranging from three to six minutes.

features.name: Multiview
features.description: There's always more than one news story developing in real-time. This exclusive feature lets you tune into multiple live feeds simultaneously.

features.name: Personalized Daily Video Briefings
features.description: Get exclusive, personalized daily video briefings on the subjects that matter most to you – every time you sign in.

features.name: Real-Time Fact Checking
features.description: Our fact checkers watch interviews and events alongside you and verify the truth via an on-screen text companion.

features.name: CNN You Streaming
features.description: Personalized streaming experience using AI, adapting your feed to your individual topic interests and viewing preferences.

features.name: Live Q&A with CNN Experts
features.description: Connect directly with anchors, experts and special guests via live, interactive conversations. Ask questions and be part of the story.

CNN All-Access.title: CNN All-Access
CNN All-Access.subtitle: CNN Reader + CNN Streaming
CNN All-Access.description: Your all-access pass to the CNN universe – unlimited articles, short-form videos, and live and on-demand streaming content. Get the breaking news coverage, depth and authority that only CNN's global newsroom can deliver, whenever you need it, on CNN.com, CNN Streaming, and the app.

CNN Standalone Vertical.title: CNN Standalone Vertical
CNN Standalone Vertical.subtitle: Focused Content Subscription
CNN Standalone Vertical.description: A focused subscription to a specific content vertical like Entertainment Tracker, Meditation & Mindfulness, or Personal Finance, targeting your specific interests with deep, specialized coverage.
